CustomObject.description: One row every time a safety net corrects the agent. Exists because the nets were silently rewriting replies with no record, which meant the QA evaluator graded the CORRECTED transcript and the real hallucination and refusal rates were invisible. Without this the build cannot state its own failure rate. Holds no personal data: the figures or refusal phrase only, never the veteran's words.
CustomObject.label: NM Guardrail Event
